---
title: Round seven controls
summary: Indefinite pronouns the last list missed, and a fence nested in a list.
lang: en
---

Everything's ready and anything's possible, so no one's waiting.

The pronouns that must stay silent: Menlo's metrics, the apps' settings,
someone in the room, everything about it, no one at all.

1. Run the build and read what it prints.

    ```sh
    $ orca build
    error: can't open file, and it isn't on the path either
    ```

    The pasted line above is code. The word above and below it is prose.

2. A deeper fence, eight spaces in:

        ```text
        we're not prose, we've never been prose
        ```

Back at the margin, this sentence is prose and has no contraction.
